## Emerald 2.2.2-dev.4

This prerelease removes pointer confinement from every Emerald dialog and makes
the application-update percentage readable throughout a download.

### Pointer-friendly dialogs

- Confirmations, folder/vault name prompts, the mascot gallery, spelling and
  theme editors, file and color pickers, What's New, update messages, and the
  update progress window now use the same non-modal presentation as Settings.
- This avoids compositor-level pointer grabs when an XCB AppImage runs through
  XWayland, while preserving each action's existing synchronous result.
- Closing Emerald or switching vaults safely unwinds the deepest open dialog
  first, including dialogs opened from inside Settings.

### Update progress

- The application updater now draws its numeric percentage in a dedicated
  label beside the progress bar instead of over the filled portion.
- The percentage continues to advance using the verified release size when the
  server does not provide a transfer total.
- Cancel still aborts the request and removes the partial download.

### Testing notes

- Open each available dialog, especially nested spelling/theme dialogs and file
  or color pickers, and confirm the pointer can move freely outside the box.
- Start an application update and confirm the progress bar contains no text and
  the percentage remains readable beside it from 0% through 100%.
- On the Development channel, restart `2.2.2-dev.3` and confirm the automatic
  startup check offers this `dev.4` build.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
